text.p: -- J.P. Morgan analyst Brian Pearl started coverage of Grupo Financiero Banacci on Wednesday with a rating of market underperformer.
-- "Banamex, Grupo Financiero Banacci's banking subsidiary, should suffer a sharp decline in earnings before provisions and taxes (EBPT) over the next several quarters," he wrote in a report.
-- "... This decline in expected EBPT should be the result of a year-over-year compression in net interest margin from 4.5 percent in 1996 to 2.9 percent in 1997."
-- He set a 12-month price target for the company's B shares of 12.04 pesos.
-- The shares were off 0.28 peso to 18.20 in Mexico City.
